race.comment: WANTED ENUFF (7) is worth following up after being beaten just under two lengths at Hamilton when bumped at the start and held up passing the 200m, and she should take benefit from that first-up run. SEVEN DAY REBELS (2) resumes from five months off after a Balnarring trial win; his Moe run was plain, but a debut second at Bendigo is good form for this, respect. VALENTINA GIRL (10) is progressing and has good early speed, so should be able to take full advantage of the inside pillar. Expect her to be the one they need to reel in. REINA DEL RIO (6)  returns off a long break and while she may need a run or two, her trials suggest she's ready to go. Keeping safe.
